name: t54 Labs
description: Underwrites AI agent payments before they execute: the Trustline risk API scores agent transactions, and X402 Secure adds risk checks to x402 payments on XRPL.

skills.name: Assess Agent Transactions
skills.description: Submits an agent transaction to the Trustline async underwriting API and polls for an allow, deny or review decision.

skills.name: Secure x402 Payments
skills.description: Binds reasoning traces, Verifiable Intent and AP2 mandates to an x402 payment and returns a risk decision before settlement.

skills.name: Pay with x402 on XRPL
skills.description: Verifies and settles x402 exact-scheme payments on the XRP Ledger through t54's hosted XRPL x402 Facilitator.

skills.name: Resolve Agentic Challenges
skills.description: Asks the agent for more evidence when a transaction lacks it, through the Agentic Challenge flow, instead of declining.

skills.name: Export Audit Evidence
skills.description: Records tamper-evident evidence for every underwriting decision so compliance teams can verify and export it.
